scenes.narration: Every item handed in to lost property this month was found on the fourth floor. This building does not have a fourth floor.
scenes.imagePrompt: Dozens of brown luggage tags hanging on strings from the shelves of a wire mesh lost property cage, all turned the same way, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: THE LIFT SKIPS FROM THREE TO FIVE
scenes.narration: I went up to look. The lift panel goes three, then five. The stairs go from three to five without a landing.
scenes.imagePrompt: An old brass lift button panel in a dim lift car, round buttons glowing amber, seen at an angle with the numbers too soft to read, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: I asked building services which floor that means. They laughed. Then they asked who had written the tags.

scenes.narration: I said I had. That is what the log says. I just do not remember going there.
